title: Set notation & Venn regions
examples: What is the difference between union and intersection?
How do I shade the complement of a set?
Can you explain what the symbol subset means?

explain.say: Today we learn about set notation and Venn diagrams. We will use symbols like belongs to and is a subset of. Let us start with the symbol for element of.
The symbol ∈ means that an item belongs inside a set. For example, the number three belongs to the set of small numbers.
Next we look at the subset symbol, which is ⊂. This means one set is entirely inside another set. Think of it like a small box inside a big box.
The union symbol is ∪, which means all elements from both sets together. We combine everything into one new set. For example, A union B has everything in A or B.

draw.text: A ∪ B = {x | x in A or x in B}

explain.say: The intersection symbol is ∩. This means we only keep the elements that are in both sets. It is the overlap area between the two sets. For instance, A intersection B has items in both A and B.

draw.text: A ∩ B = {x | x in A and x in B}

faq.q: What is the difference between union and intersection?
faq.a: The union combines all elements from both sets into one group. The intersection only keeps the elements that are common to both sets.
asks: How is A union B different from A intersection B?
What does it mean to combine two sets?

faq.q: How do I find the complement of a set?
faq.a: The complement of a set shows everything that is not in that set but is still in the larger universal set. You shade everything outside the circle.
asks: What is the complement of A?
How do I shade A prime?

faq.q: Does subset mean the sets are equal?
faq.a: No, subset means one set is contained within another set. The sets could be equal, but they do not have to be equal.
asks: If A ⊂ B, does A = B?
What is the relationship between subset and equality?

faq.q: What is the universal set in these diagrams?
faq.a: The universal set is the entire collection of all items we are considering for the problem. It represents the whole space where the sets exist.
asks: Where does the universal set come from?

faq.q: Can I use Venn diagrams for more than two sets?
faq.a: Yes, you can use Venn diagrams for three or even four sets. You will just need more overlapping circles to show all the relationships.
asks: Do I need a new diagram for three sets?
Is it possible to show three sets in one diagram?

facts: The symbol ∈ means that an element belongs to a set.
The symbol ⊂ means that one set is a subset of another set.
The union symbol ∪ combines all elements from both sets.
The intersection symbol ∩ shows elements common to both sets.
The complement of a set shows elements outside that set.

quiz.say: If Set P is {2, 4, 6} and Set Q is {4, 8, 10}, what is P ∩ Q?
quiz.why: The intersection only keeps elements that appear in both set P and set Q, which is only the number four.

wrong.0: This option incorrectly repeats the element instead of listing the unique common element.
wrong.2: This option mixes elements from both sets but does not only show the common ones.
wrong.3: This option is the union, which includes every element from both sets combined.

quiz.say: If the universal set is all integers, and Set A is {x | x is even}, what is A′?
quiz.why: The complement shows everything in the universal set that is not in set A. If A is even numbers, its complement must be odd numbers.

wrong.0: This option only lists one specific number, ignoring all other possibilities.
wrong.1: The complement is not an empty set because there are odd numbers in the universal set.
wrong.2: This option is the set A itself, not its complement.

quiz.say: Given A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {3, 4, 5}, what is A ∪ B?
quiz.why: The union combines every unique element from set A and every unique element from set B into one set.

wrong.0: This option writes an intersection symbol when it should be combining all elements.
wrong.2: This option only shows the intersection, ignoring the unique elements of A and B.
wrong.3: This option forgot to include the element three, which is in both sets.
